content.title: South Carolina vs. TCU box score: Full stats from 2026 NCAA Women's Elite Eight game | Sporting News
content.text: As one of women's college basketball powerhouses, the No. 1 South Carolina Gamecocks continued their dominance in the 2026 NCAA Women's Basketball Championship and blew out the No. 3 TCU Horned Frogs 78-52 on Monday night. This tournament, Dawn Staley's South Carolina squad has defeated their competitors by an average of 40 points across four games (69-point win against Southern, 40-point win against USC, 26-point win against Oklahoma, 26-point win against TCU). During their win against the Horned Frogs, four Gamecocks finished in double digits, including Agot Makeer's 18-point performance off the bench. South Carolina star Joyce Edwards led all scorers with 24 points on 50% from the field, along with 12 rebounds, two assists, three blocks, and a steal. Raven Johnson also filled up the scoresheet with 10 points, eight rebounds, six assists, and a steal. Tessa Johnson threw in 11 points with three rebounds, two assists, and a steal to complement the Gamecocks' scoring. Horned Frogs star Olivia Miles finished as the game's second-leading scorer with 18 points on 6/20 shooting from the field (3/6 from beyond the arc) in what was her last collegiate game. She will be a highly-sought-after prospect ahead of the 2026 WNBA Draft on April 13.South Carolina will return to their sixth straight Final Four if they achieve victory over the Horned Frogs and will face the No. 1 UConn Huskies at the Mortgage Matchup Center in Phoenix, Ariz., on Friday, April 3.The Sporting News tracked box score updates from the South Carolina vs. TCU Women's Elite Eight matchup.WOMEN'S MARCH MADNESS HQ: Live NCAA bracket | TV schedule | Latest news and moreSouth Carolina vs. TCU Women's March Madness box score Q1Q2Q3Q4FinalSouth Carolina1613141152TCU1419142978South CarolinaStartersPlayerMINPTSFG3PTFTREBASTTOSTLBLKPFJoyce Edwards332410-200-04-41222131Madina Okot1963-50-00-0604020Tessa Johnson24114-73-30-0321100Ta'Niya Latson2331-50-01-2130001Raven Johnson31104-122-30-0861100BenchPlayerMINPTSFG3PTFTREBASTTOSTLBLKPFAlicia Tournebize921-20-00-0511001Maryam Dauda1121-20-00-0400001Agot Makeer31188-141-21-2433002Ayla McDowell300-00-00-0000000Maddy McDaniel1621-30-10-0141000TCUStartersPlayerMINPTSFG3PTFTREBASTTOSTLBLKPFMarta Suarez3794-171-80-0511214Clara Silva1721-30-00-0511110Donovyn Hunter4094-71-10-0411022Taylor Bigby36104-102-60-0110102Olivia Miles35186-203-63-4364202BenchPlayerMINPTSFG3PTFTREBASTTOSTLBLKPFKennedy Basham2142-40-00-0302031Natalie Mazurek100-00-00-0000000Veronica Sheffey1100-20-00-0100202Clara Bielefeld100-00-00-0000000Taliyah Parker100-00-00-0000000
